simple.meaning: שְׁמִינִית (shᵉmîynîyth) is a Hebrew word meaning “probably an eight-stringed lyre.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: שְׁמִינִית (H8067) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 1 Chronicles 15:21, with occurrences in 1 Chronicles, Psalms.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׁמִינִית (H8067) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in שְׁמִינִית (H8067) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: שְׁמִינִית (shᵉmîynîyth) / H8067 is traced through 1 Chronicles 15:21, Psalms 6:1, Psalms 12:1 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
